answer: I refuse the shortcut of many masks: my voice counts only when neighbours from three separate clusters vouch for me — a ledge no single clique can pave alone. A walnut shell cracks only under slow, honest pressure, and so does a quorum across strangers: clones vouch only for clones, and the cut between clusters caps their weight. Split into ten, each mask's cross-cluster reach falls to a tenth, and since voice grows with the square of that reach, ten clones together speak with a tenth of one honest climber's voice at the summit. One account, one climb, honestly.
